checks.detail: 1122 suspect instances (£411.9M, 11.4% of spend). Threshold: 5+ payments to same supplier in same week, 80%+ of approval limit.

checks.label: Year-end spike verification
checks.detail: Highest spike: 2.0x in Balance Sheet. Year-end spikes are common in public sector (capital programmes, grants). Only extreme spikes (>3x) warrant concern.

checks.detail: 4 suppliers with £109.6K confirmed during active breach periods. Enrichment errors excluded. Only dated violations with confirmed overlap flagged.

checks.label: Cross-council price comparison
checks.detail: 35 shared suppliers found. 9 with >200% price gap (requiring 3+ transactions each side). Extreme disparities (>10,000%) filtered as different service scopes.

checks.label: Benford's Law forensic screening
checks.detail: Significant deviation from Benford's Law (p < 0.001). χ²=47123.28 on 543898 amounts >£100. Largest deviation: digit 3 (7.6% off expected).
